From pre-made boxes to the option to customize your luxury Chocolate box, which is what I did! I selected 25 pieces like New York Style Cheesecake to White Truffle to Root Beer Float, plus so many milk and dark chocolate options. And knowing this chocolatier dates back to 1668 Paris and once served royalty makes sense with the luxe packaging because the presentation is everything.
